projects.title: VARWIX
projects.subtitle: Financial data science and quantitative risk platform
projects.summary: A three-tier risk and ML platform for quantitative analysis, with a Monte Carlo risk engine and forecasting models.
highlights: 3-tier platform: React dashboard, Spring Boot gateway with JWT auth, Python analytics microservice.
Serves 15+ quant and ML models to 200+ beta users at 99.5% uptime.
Risk engine for historical and parametric VaR and CVaR, with a 10,000-path Monte Carlo GBM.
Optimised portfolios backtested 18% higher Sharpe ratio than equal-weight.
Forecasting (ARIMA, GARCH, LSTM) and an XGBoost and Random Forest ensemble: 35% lower MAPE than a naive baseline.
Cut p95 analytics latency 82% (1.8 s to 320 ms) with Redis caching and indexed PostgreSQL tables.

projects.title: Ideociety
projects.subtitle: AI-powered smart residential society platform
projects.summary: Role-based society management with a 3D society map, live CCTV coverage and computer-vision gate automation.
highlights: Role-based society management across 8 Spring Boot modules: visitor passes, billing, complaints, amenity booking.
Piloted with 120+ households; cut complaint resolution time by 40%.
Interactive 3D society map (React and Three.js) showing 24 live CCTV camera pointers, alerts and coverage.
Guard response time cut 35%.
YOLOv8 and OCR number-plate recognition at 96% accuracy and 15 FPS per stream, automating 500+ daily gate entries.

projects.title: Grabito
projects.subtitle: Intelligent food delivery platform
projects.summary: Real-time order tracking, rider assignment simulation and AI features for a food delivery product.
highlights: Real-time order tracking over WebSockets with sub-200 ms location updates.
Kafka pipeline handling 5,000 events/s across 1,000+ concurrent simulated orders.
Rider assignment and order-batching simulator (Hungarian matching, geospatial clustering) cut rider idle distance by 22%.
Address intelligence for the last 50 metres cut failed deliveries by 30%.
AI features: conversational cart builder, rider voice assistant, menu digitisation (OCR and LLM), coupon-fraud detection flagging 92% of test fraud cases.
projects.status: Verify: which features are built and which are planned

projects.title: NeRF Vision
projects.subtitle: Sparse-view NeRF and camouflaged object detection
projects.summary: Reproduction of FreeNeRF in nerfstudio for sparse views, plus a camouflaged-object detection pipeline.
highlights: Reproduced FreeNeRF in nerfstudio for reconstruction from 3 to 8 views; gained 2.1 dB PSNR over vanilla NeRF at 3 views, with higher SSIM.
Camouflaged-object detection reaching F1 0.84 and IoU 0.78, with ablations across view counts and occlusion levels.
UCS532 Computer Vision project, built with Tanishq and supervised by Dr. Shailendra Tiwari.
